home.hero.title: ASTROZ COMM.
home.hero.lead: We believe everyone has the right to help shape the future of technology.
home.mission.title: OUR MISSION
home.mission.body: We believe change begins when someone dares to try something new. That is why ASTROZ exists to bring together technology, ideas, and the courage to create meaningful change.
home.mission.body2: To us, technology is not merely a tool to make things faster or more efficient. Technology is a way to create opportunities, solve problems, and empower more people to take part in shaping the future.
home.mission.quote: Courage is not having the strength to keep going—it is continuing to move forward even when you have no strength left.
home.social.title: FROM THE FEED
home.social.intro: Dispatches from our social channels: what we are building, where we show up, and who we build it with.
home.pillars.title: MOVEMENT PILLARS
home.pillars.intro: We build technology as a space to learn, experiment, collaborate, and create real solutions. For ASTROZ, technology doesn't just belong to the best, but is open to anyone brave enough to try and co-create.
home.cta.title: We are looking forward to having you join us.
